choices: Choose a full speech-to-text stack first, then collect data after the architecture is fixed.
Make next-step decisions quickly so the team can iterate through evidence and failures faster.
Delay implementation until every likely model family has been deeply read and compared.
Optimize the embedded hardware first, then decide what learning problem the model should solve.

question_bank.question: When starting the custom wake-word problem, what search strategy does the instructor favor before committing to one implementation path?
